name: @singularity/plugin-network-live
description: Unified live-resource API. core: liveCollection (one declaration minting a bounded window resource, its point-set `:rows` sibling and its `:groups` grouping; optional boot preload of the window; filterable columns declared as filter-language domains), LiveWhere (per-column sugar or a Filter tree), and the strict canonical query codecs over the filter language's codec. server: serveCollection (binds a collection's row fields to a table's columns — the projection is the row schema — ANDs a base where into every read, and compiles all three resources, filters through filterSql). web: useLive (window or grouping with canGrow/growing/loadMore, or an id set) and useLiveRow (pending / found / absent).
